description: Movie-poster style meme titled 'FISAGATE' against a fiery orange sky, composited with portraits of Barack Obama (center), Hillary Clinton, James Comey, Loretta Lynch, and Andrew McCabe. Below the title, five-star 'review' quotes about the Nunes FISA memo are attributed to Republican congressmen Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, Matt Gaetz, Steve King, and Scott Perry. The poster frames the FISA controversy as a scandal implicating the pictured officials.
text: FISAGATE. "What I saw is absolutely shocking." Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the scariest of places." Matt Gaetz. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen." Steve King. "As soon as you read the Memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB?" Scott Perry.
flags: Meme implies wrongdoing by the pictured officials — an unverified framing; the quotes are congressmen's real-style reactions to the FISA memo presented as movie reviews
